extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology closeout from paper-local XML/PDF text and figure captions; placeholder framework-test mechanism claims replaced.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly supports rapid antimicrobial killing/activity in bioluminescent time-kill assays for selected designed peptides against P. aeruginosa and S. aureus; this is functional kill evidence, not a resolved molecular target mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RP553, RP556, RP557, and comparator RP504 where reported in Figure 3/results prose
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay supports rapid killing percentages/time course; it does not by itself prove a membrane-disruption molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Membrane perturbation, ergosterol interaction, biofilm activity, and resistance-development statements are treated as background/mechanistic context from prior AMP literature rather than direct mechanism evidence newly demonstrated for every peptide in this paper.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: designed antimicrobial peptides discussed in introduction/discussion
mechanism_claims.limitations: No local direct membrane permeabilization, ergosterol-binding, or biofilm assay table for these exact database rows is present in this paper packet.

caution_findings.impact: Rapid kill is accepted as direct functional evidence; molecular membrane/biofilm mechanism remains contextual unless directly assayed.
